emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Warmth, Family-First Care)

design_direction.vibe: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day editorial warmth. High-craft, human-centered school transit site. Soft organic shapes, badge trust strips, signature masked line-by-line reveal hero, clipped polaroid/spotlight frames, and floating sticky mobile CTA.
anti_patterns: NO generic corporate blue or cold tech gradients (#7351B7 or #1B93A4 forbidden)
NO rigid square boxes — use organic rounded corners (rounded-2xl, rounded-3xl)
NO Inter/Roboto for main titles — use warm display serif and organic humanist fonts
NO placeholder text for logos or trust badges — render real micro SVG badges
NO plain full-screen dark overlays over photos — keep overlays light and warm

typography.head_font: Fraunces / Playfair Display / Cabinet Grotesk (Warm Display Serif & Expressive Headings)
typography.body_font: Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans (Friendly, organic, ultra-legible)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (For route codes and timestamps)

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
hierarchy.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight text-amber-950

tailwind_palette.cta-primary: bg-[#E87A5D] hover:bg-[#D9684B] text-white shadow-lg shadow-[#E87A5D]/25 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-0.5

logo_and_mark.concept: Mama's Sunburst Van SVG Mark - A stylized, gentle line-art illustration combining a sun, heart, and family van route path.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis momentum smooth scrolling enabled on all main views
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Framer motion line-by-line staggered text reveal on initial load
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Section components wrap content with Framer Motion scroll triggers (y: 20 -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1)
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial text ticker (15s duration) with organic warm tint separator dots
motion_and_interactions.interactive_cards: Hover transform tilt & soft shadow lift (-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl)

reusable_components.waitlist_component: Card element displaying 'This route is currently full. Join our priority waitlist to be notified when a seat opens up!' with name & email input + instant submit confirmation
reusable_components.sticky_mobile_cta: Bottom bar fixed on mobile screens with 'CHECK ROUTE AVAILABILITY' button always visible
reusable_components.trust_strip: Horizontal strip featuring 5 icon badges (Criminal Record Checked, First-Aid Certified, Door-to-Door, SMS Notifications, Edmonton Local)
reusable_components.nav_bar: Glassmorphism header with SVG Logo, desktop links, 'CHECK ROUTE AVAILABILITY' dominant CTA button, mobile drawer

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the provided colors, font classes, and warm organic editorial aesthetic.
Add data-testid to every interactive button, input, link, and major content card.
Use mock database handlers (localStorage or state) for the inquiry form and waitlist form submissions so user interactions complete gracefully with visual confirmations.
Ensure Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion animations run smoothly without blocking accessibility or user interactions.
